title: Integral formula under monotonicity and Boolean range
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the subsets of an $n$-element set that is monotone under inclusion and takes only the values $0$ and $1$. For every element $i$ of that set, the Shapley value of $f$ at $i$ equals the integral from $0$ to $1$ of its Bernoulli marginal contribution as the inclusion probability varies.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an element of the underlying $n$-element set
